title: THE 6AM PRAYER THAT MAKES DEMONS FLEE BEFORE SUNRISE
text: Hallelujah. Somebody help me worship him tonight. Just lift your voice and worship the King of Kings, the Lion of the Tribe of Judah, the ancient of days, the one who was, who is, and who is to come. Hallelujah. We give you glory, Father. We give you honor. We give you praise. There is none like you in all the earth. There is none like you in the heavens above. You are God and beside you, there is no other. Hallelujah. Just worship him. Don't be in a hurry tonight. Something is about to happen in this atmosphere. I can sense it. The presence of God is thick in this place. Hallelujah. We worship you, Lord. We magnify your holy name. You are worthy, Lord. You are worthy of all our praise. Hallelujah. Father, we thank you for this gathering. We thank you for everyone connected to this service right now. Wherever they are watching from, wherever they are listening from, Lord, I pray that this would not be an ordinary night, let something shift in the realm of the spirit, let something change in the lives of your people. Hallelujah. We worship you, Jesus. We worship you. Hallelujah. Are you ready to receive? Let me hear you say, "I am ready." Hallelujah. The title of tonight's ministration is the 6 a.m. prayer that makes demons flee before sunrise. Let me say it again. The 6 a.m. prayer that makes demons flee before sunrise. Hallelujah. This is a prophetic instruction. This is a spiritual strategy. This is a weapon that God is releasing to his people in this a season. Hallelujah. Open your Bible to the book of Mark chapter 1. Mark chapter 1. Are you there? Hallelujah. Mark 1 verse35, the Bible says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." Did you see that? In the morning, rising up a great while before day, before the sun came up, before dawn, before sunrise, Jesus was already in prayer. Hallelujah. This was not accidental. This was strategic. This was intentional. Jesus understood something that many believers have not yet discovered. There is power in the early morning hour. There is something that happens when you meet God before the world wakes up. Hallelujah. Let let me give you another scripture. Psalm 63:1 David said, "Oh God, thou art my God. Early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee. My flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land where no water is. Did you see that word? Early will I seek thee, not late, not when it is convenient, not when I finished attending to everything else. Early first thing before anything else. Hallelujah. Let me share something with you tonight that will change your prayer life forever. The kingdom of darkness has a timetable. Demons operate on schedules. Witches and wizards gather at specific times. Covens meet at designated hours. And one of the most strategic times for satanic operations is between the hours of 12, midnight, and 6:00 a.m. Hallelujah. This is the period the Bible calls the night. This is when the enemy does his most devastating work. This is when arrows are shot. This is when evil verdicts are passed. This is when destinies are manipulated. This is when covenants are activated. Hallelujah. But here is the revelation. The devil cannot extend his operations past a certain time. There is a boundary. There is a limit. And that limit is the rising of the sun. Hallelujah. Psalm 104:22, the Bible says, "The sun ariseth. They gather themselves together and lay them down in their dens." Did you see that? When the sun rises, demons must retreat. When daylight comes, darkness must flee. There is something about the breaking of the day that causes a shift in the spirit realm. Hallelujah. Now, here is the prophetic instruction. If you want to catch the enemy and destroy his works before they manifest in your life, you must beat him to his own deadline. You must rise before sunrise. You must be in the place of prayer while demons are still trying to seal their operations. Hallelujah. 6:00 in the morning. That is the hour. That is the moment. That is the point of transition. The devil is trying to seal his work from the night. And you as a child of God must rise up in prayer and anol everything he has done. Hallelujah. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are catching the enemy at his most vulnerable point. He has finished his operations. He's about to retreat. But before he can escape with his evil verdict, you confront him in the place of prayer and you scatter everything he has done. Hallelujah. This is why Jesus rose a great while before day. This is why David said, "Early will I seek thee." This is why the psalm is declared in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and we look up." Hallelujah. The morning is a strategic time for spiritual warfare. It is a time to intercept the plans of the enemy. It is a time to reverse satanic decrees. It is a time to release prophetic declarations over your day, your week, your month, your year. Hallelujah. Let me tell you something. Many believers are losing battles they should be winning because they are sleeping when they should be praying. They are resting when they should be wrestling. They are comfortable when they should be confronting. Hallelujah. The Bible says in Proverbs 6:es 9-11, "How long will thou sleep, oh sloggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep? Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep. So shall thy poverty come as one that traveleth and thy wand as an armed man. Did you see that? While you are sleeping, poverty is traveling towards you. While you are slumbering, lack is marching in your direction. While your hands are folded, an armed man is coming to steal from you. Hallelujah. The enemy loves sleeping believers. He loves Christians who cannot sacrifice their comfort for the sake of their destiny. He loves men and women who would rather enjoy an extra hour of sleep than rise up and take authority over the powers of darkness. Hallelujah. But tonight something is about to change. Tonight God is awakening warriors. Tonight the spirit of God is raising prayer generals. Tonight you are receiving an impartation for early morning intercession that will transform your life. Hallelujah. Let me teach you something. The 6:00 a.m. prayer is not just about waking up early. It is about understanding the spiritual dynamics of that hour. Hallelujah. Number one, 6:00 a.m. is the hour of transition. It is the moment when the night shifts into day. It is the boundary between darkness and light. And in the spirit realm, transitions are powerful. There are moments when things can shift dramatically. Hallelujah. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are standing at the gateway between two realms. You are positioning yourself at the intersection of darkness and light. And from that position, you have authority to command what happens in your day. Hallelujah. Number two, 6:00 a.m. is the hour of anolment. Everything the enemy did in the night can be annoled at this hour. Every arrow shot can be returned. Every verdict passed can be reversed. Every covenant activated can be destroyed. Hallelujah. This is why the devil does not want you to pray at this hour. He knows that if you rise before the sun, you will catch him in his wickedness. You will intercept his plans. You will scatter his operations. Hallelujah. Number three, 6:00 a.m. is the hour of declaration. It is the hour when you set the agenda for your day before the enemy can. It is the hour when you prophesy into the atmosphere and command the day to align with the will of God for your life. Hallelujah. Job 38:12, God asked Job, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began and cause the daypring to know his place?" Did you see that? commanding the morning, causing the daypring to know its place. This is what you do when you pray at 6:00 a.m. You take authority over the day. You tell the morning what it should bring into your life. You command the dayr to release favor, breakthrough, miracles, and blessings. Hallelujah. Many believers have never commanded their morning. They wake up and simply accept whatever the day brings. They are passive recipients of circumstances. They are not active commanders of their atmosphere. Hallelujah. But tonight that is changing. Tonight you are receiving revelation. Tonight you are being empowered to take authority over your mornings. Tonight you are being activated for 6 a.m. warfare. Hallelujah. Let me give you another scripture. Lamentations 3:es 22- 23. The Bible says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." Did you see that? God's mercies are new every morning. Every single morning, there is a fresh release from heaven. There is a new allocation of grace. There is a fresh dispensation of mercy. Hallelujah. But here is the question. Do you position yourself to receive what heaven is releasing every morning? Do you wake up early enough to access the fresh messes of God? Or do you sleep through the morning and miss what heaven was distributing? Hallelujah. Some believers are living below their allocation. They should be receiving abundant grace, but they getting crumbs. They should be walking in overflowing mercy, but they are experiencing lack. And the reason is simple. They are not positioning themselves at the right time. Hallelujah. God said through the prophet Isaiah in Isaiah 50:4. The Lord God had given me the tongue of the land that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakenth morning by morning. He wakenth mine ear to hear as the lanet. Did you see that? Morning by morning, God wakes the ear. God gives instruction. God releases revelation. But you must be awake to receive it. Hallelujah. This is not just about praying. This is about hearing. This is about receiving divine direction. This is about accessing supernatural intelligence. Hallelujah. When you pray at 6:00 a.m., you are not just talking to God. You are positioning yourself to hear from God. You are opening your ears to receive instructions for the day. You are tuning into the frequency of heaven. Hallelujah. And when you hear from God in the morning, you will navigate the day with wisdom. You will make decisions that align with divine will. You will avoid traps that the enemy has set for you. You will walk in supernatural guidance. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Glory to God. Glory to God. Hallelujah. I am sensing a strong prophetic flow right now. The spirit of God is beginning to minister. Hallelujah. Let me tell you something. There are battles you have been fighting that should have been over a long time ago. There are situations in your life that have persisted beyond their time. There are strongholds that should have been broken years ago. And the reason they are still standing is because you have not engaged the 6 a.m. warfare. Hallelujah. But tonight that changes. Tonight you are receiving a weapon. Tonight you are being armed for battle. Tonight the spirit of God is teaching you how to make demons flee before sunrise. Hallelujah. Let me shift now. I want to begin to pray. But before we pray, let me give you prophetic instructions. Hallelujah. Beginning from tomorrow morning, I want you to wake up at 6:00 a.m. Don't snooze your alarm. Don't negotiate with your body. Don't make excuses. Wake up at 6:00 a.m. Hallelujah. And when you wake up, the first thing you do is not check your phone. The first thing you do is not respond to messages. The first thing you do is get on your knees and begin to pray. Hallelujah. In fact, let me give you a strategy. For the next 7 days, I want you to engage in 6:00 a.m. warfare. Wake up every morning at 6:00 a.m. Pray for at least 1 hour and watch what will begin to happen in your life. Hallelujah. Some of you have been under attacks that you cannot explain. Things have been happening in your life that do not make sense. You have been experiencing setbacks that have no logical reason. And the truth is there has been satanic activity against you in the night hours. Hallelujah. But when you begin to pray at 6:00 a.m., you will begin to intercept those operations. You will begin to destroy those works of darkness. You will begin to experience breakthroughs that you have been waiting for. Hallelujah. Are you ready to pray? Let me hear you say, "I am ready." Hallelujah. Stand to your feet wherever you are right now. Stand to your feet. We're about to enter into warfare. Hallelujah. Raise your right hand towards heaven. I want you to pray this prayer with fire. This is not a casual prayer. This is warfare. Hallelujah. Begin to pray. Father, I thank you for this revelation. I thank you for opening my eyes to the power of the early morning hour. I thank you for teaching me how to make demons flee before sunrise. From this day forward, I commit to rising early to seek your face. I commit to engaging in 6:00 a.m. warfare. I commit to commanding my mornings and taking authority over my days in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Now, I want you to pray this prayer with everything in you. Every operation of darkness that was concluded against me last night, I cancel it now. I anol it now. I reverse it now. Every arrow that was shot at my destiny while I was sleeping, I return it to sender. Every verdict that was passed against my life in the covenants of witchcraft, I overturn it by the blood of Jesus. Every covenant that was activated against my progress, I destroy it now. I break it now. I set myself free in the name of Jesus. Pray that prayer. Pray it with fire. Hallelujah. Shandle shand. Hallelujah. I I'm sensing something in the spirit right now. There is someone under this sound of my voice whose destiny was attacked last night. While you were sleeping, the enemy held a meeting concerning you. They passed a verdict. They issued a decree. They said you would not rise. They said this year would not favor you. They said your breakthrough would be blocked. But tonight, I am standing as a prophet of the most high God. And I am reversing that verdict. I am annulling that decree. I am breaking that evil decision in the name of Jesus. You are free. Your destiny is released. Your breakthrough is secured. Receive it now. Hallelujah. Continue to pray. Every household wickedness that has been working against my progress, I bind it now. I cast it out now. I destroy its power over my life. My father's house cannot stop me. My mother's house cannot delay me. No ancestral power can hold me down. I am free by the blood Jesus. Pray that prayer. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Father, I thank you for freedom. I thank you for deliverance. I thank you for breaking the chains of household wickedness. Hallelujah. Now, I want you to pray for your family. There are members of your family who are under attack. There are people in your bloodline who are being held captive by the powers of darkness. Tonight, you are standing as an intercessor. You are standing in the gap for your family. Hallelujah. Begin to pray. Father, I lift my family before you tonight. Every member of my family who is under satanic attack, I release them now. Every cause that is operating in my family line, I break it by the blood of Jesus. Every generational pattern of failure, poverty, sickness, and death, I terminate it tonight. My family shall be saved. My family shall be delivered. My family shall serve the Lord in the name of Jesus. Pray that prayer with fire. Hallelujah. Shabarakia mandel sha. Hallelujah. I decree over your family tonight. Salvation shall visit your house. Deliverance shall come to your loved ones. Every prodigal son shall return. Every prodigal daughter shall come back. The spirit of deception over your family members is broken now. The scales are falling from their eyes. They are seeing the light of the gospel. They are coming into the kingdom. Receive it in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Continue to pray. Let me give you another prayer point. This is for those who are believing God for marriage. There are some of you who have been waiting for a long time. You have prayed, you have fasted, you have believed God, but the manifestation seems to be delayed. Tonight, I want you to understand something. The delay is not from God. The delay is from the enemy. There are forces that have been blocking your marital breakthrough. There are powers that have been hindering the manifestation of your destiny partner. But tonight, we are breaking those barriers. Hallelujah. Begin to pray. Father, I come before you tonight concerning my marital destiny. Every power that is blocking my marriage, I command it to lose its hold now. Every spirit of delay that has been hindering my breakthrough, I bind it and cast it out. Every evil monitoring spirit that is carrying away my destiny helpers, I destroy its power over my life. I decree that my marriage shall manifest. I decree that my destiny partner shall locate me. I decree that this season of waiting is over in the name of Jesus. Pray that prayer. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am prophesying over someone right now. Within the next few months, you will testify the one God has ordained for you is already being prepared. The encounter is already being arranged by heaven. You will not miss your connection. You will not miss your divine alignment. Your marriage shall manifest. Receive it now. Hallelujah. For those who are already married, I want you to pray for your marriage. There are some marriages under attack tonight. The enemy is trying to bring division. He's trying to sow discord. He's trying to destroy what God has joined together. But tonight, we are standing against his devices. Hallelujah. Begin to pray. Father, I cover my marriage with the blood of Jesus. Every attack against my home, I neutralize it now. Every spirit of strife, contention, and division, I cast it out of my marriage. My marriage shall not fail. My home shall not be destroyed. What God has joined together. No devil shall put us under. I decree peace in my home. I decree love in my marriage. I decree unity between me and my spouse in the name of Jesus. Pray that prayer with fire. Hallelujah. Shandelaba shiata mandelor. Hallelujah. I decree over every marriage connected to this service tonight. The fire of God is surrounding your home. No evil shall penetrate. No attack shall prosper. No weapon formed against your union shall succeed. Your marriage is protected. Your marriage is preserved. Your marriage is blessed. Receive it in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Now let me shift to another area. This is for financial breakthrough. Hallelujah. There are some of you who have been experiencing financial challenges. Money comes but it does not stay. You work hard but you have nothing to show for it. There seems to be a hole in your pocket. There seems to be a leakage in your finances. Hallelujah. Tonight, I want you to understand that there are spiritual forces that specialize in stealing finances. There are demons whose assignment is to drain your resources. There are evil patterns in family lines that perpetuate poverty. But tonight, we are breaking those patterns. We are destroying those demons. We are opening the gates of financial abundance. Hallelujah. Begin to pray. Father, I come before you tonight concerning my finances. Every devourer that has been eating my resources, I rebuke it now. Every spirit of financial leakage, I bind it and cast it out of my life. Every ancestral pattern of poverty, I break it by the blood of Jesus. I decree that my finances shall be fruitful. I decree that my resources shall multiply. I decree that the gates of financial abundance are open to me now in the name of Jesus. Pray that prayer with everything in you. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Malachi 3 10 to 11. The Bible says, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, sayaeth the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it. And I will rebuke the divorakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground, neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, sayeth the Lord of hosts." Did you see that? God promised to rebuke the devourer. God promised to open the windows of heaven. God promised to pour out blessings without measure. Hallelujah. Tonight, I am standing on that scripture and I'm releasing a prophetic decree over your finances. The devourer is rebuked. The windows of heaven are open. Blessings are pouring into your life. Resources are coming to you from unexpected sources. Financial Doors that have been closed are swinging open. Debts are being cancelled. Poverty is being destroyed. Wealth is being transferred into your hands. Receive it in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Continue to pray. Some of you have been looking for jobs. You have applied to many places. You have sent countless applications, but the doors seem to be closed. Tonight, I want you to pray for employment breakthrough. Hallelujah. Begin to pray. Father, I come before you tonight concerning my employment. Every door that has been closed against me, I command it to open now. Every power that is blocking my job opportunities, I destroy its influence over my life. I decree that favor is working on my behalf. I decree that the right doors are opening for me. I decree that employment breakthrough is coming to me speedily in the name of Jesus. Pray that prayer. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. I am prophesying over someone right now before this month runs out. You will have a job offer. The door that has been closed is opening now. The opportunity that you have been waiting for is coming. God is favoring you before the right people. God is positioning you for promotion. Receive your employment breakthrough now in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. efforts in the name of Jesus. Every tongue that has spoken evil against me be silenced forever. I rise above my enemies. I triumph over my adversaries. I walk in victory over every opposition in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Shandelaba shiata koraba mandle. Hallelujah. Now let me bring this to a close. I want to seal everything we have prayed tonight. Hallelujah. Father, I thank you for this powerful time of ministration. I thank you for the revelation that has been released. I thank you for the prayers that have been prayed. I thank you for the deliverance that has taken place. I thank you for the healing that has been released. I thank you for the breakthroughs that have been decreed. Hallelujah. Now I stand as a prophet of the most high God and I release a prophetic seal over everyone connected to this service. Hallelujah. The siege is over. I say it again. The siege is over. That prolonged battle that has troubled you for years, it ends tonight. That stubborn situation that has refused to change, it shifts tonight. That door that has been closed for so long, it opens tonight. The siege is over. Hallelujah. Walk into favor. From this moment, favor surrounds you like a shield. Everywhere you go, favor announces you. Everyone you meet, favor speaks for you. Doors open without effort. Opportunities seek you out. The right people locate you. Walk into favor. Hallelujah. Your destiny is preserved. No matter what the enemy has tried to do, he has failed. Your destiny is intact. Your purpose is secure. Your future is bright. Everything God has planned for you shall come to pass. Nothing shall be lost. Nothing shall be stolen. Nothing shall be destroyed. Your destiny is preserved. Hallelujah. I decree this week is your testimony. Before seven days are complete, you will have a story to tell. Something will happen that will make you praise God. Something will shift that will make you testify. A door will open. A blessing will come. A miracle will manifest. This week is your testimony. Hallelujah. Shandle shandak. Hallelujah. I seal you with the blood of Jesus. From the crown of your head to the sole of your feet, you are covered. No evil shall touch you. No harm shall come near you. No plague shall approach your dwelling. You are sealed. You are protected. You are preserved. Hallelujah. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in victory. The Lord goes before you. The Lord walks beside you. The Lord covers you from behind. You are surrounded by divine protection. Hallelujah. Remember the instruction. Tomorrow morning at 6:00 a.m. rise up and pray. Let that become your lifestyle. Let that become your spiritual discipline and watch how things will begin to change in your life. Demons will flee before sunrise. Darkness will scatter before your prayers. Victory will become your daily portion. Hallelujah. Share this message. Send it to someone who needs it. Post it on your platforms. Let this word go forth and change lives. Hallelujah. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, and the sweet communion of the Holy Spirit be with you now and forever more in Jesus mighty name. Amen and amen. Hallelujah. Go in peace. The service is over but the blessing continues. Shalom.
